ModMetaData.name: End the Suffering
ModMetaData.author: Bebranot
ModMetaData.description:
CONTENT WARNING: this mod depicts a colonist's suicide with a firearm, including gore. It is intended for grim, realistic playthroughs. If you are struggling yourself, please talk to someone you trust or contact a local crisis line; findahelpline.com lists services by country.
Adds a player-only action. The game never triggers it on its own.
When an adult colonist's mood has stayed below 5% for 24 in-game hours, select them and right-click them to get "End the suffering". After you confirm, the pawn stops, slowly raises the gun with shaking hands, and fires. The result depends on the weapon: small calibers destroy the brain, medium calibers the skull, and heavy calibers and shotguns the whole head. Giving any other order cancels it until the last moment.
Requirements for the action: - Firearm equipped and, with Combat Extended, loaded. Bows, grenades, launchers and melee weapons do not qualify. - Adult colonist (18+), not downed, not in a mental state, able to use their hands, with a head.
Compatibility (all optional, no hard dependency): - Combat Extended: loaded rounds are checked and consumed, and the loaded ammo sets the caliber. - Show Me Your Hands: hands follow the weapon. - [NL] Facial Animation: the face changes during the animation.
Performance: no per-pawn ticking and no comps on pawns. Tracking runs inside the existing mood update, only for player pawns. Safe to add to an existing save.
Settings let you change the mood threshold, duration and caliber thresholds.
Source: https://github.com/Bebranot/rimworld-end-the-suffering
